decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using early disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the deck features cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Not Dead After All to provide card advantage and finish the game quickly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and disruption to secure a quick victory.

The key concept of this deck revolves around utilizing the combination of cards such as Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Archon of Cruelty, Indomitable Creativity, and Leyline Binding to generate powerful effects and create advantageous board states. By manipulating the opponents' decks and consistently generating threats, the deck aims to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The inclusion of cards like Persist, Bitter Reunion, Lightning Bolt, and Thoughtseize further enhances the deck's ability to disrupt and control the opponent's plays. The mana base consisting of various fetchlands and shocklands ensures consistent access to the necessary colors.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creature cards to combo off and generate value. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, Agatha's Soul Cauldron, and Grist, the Hunger Tide to create powerful synergies and control the board. With the help of Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to fit the situation. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the right combination of creatures to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive play and disruption. It aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through cards like Thoughtseize and Grist, the Hunger Tide. It also includes strong removal spells like Maelstrom Pulse and Fatal Push to efficiently deal with threats. The deck utilizes a combination of creatures with high power and toughness, such as Tarmogoyf and Orcish Bowmasters, to apply pressure and maintain board presence. Additionally, it includes disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief to disrupt the opponent's plans and gain value.

The key concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy by utilizing a mix of different colored creatures and versatile spells. The deck focuses on utilizing cards that can deal damage quickly, such as Wild Nacatl and Lightning Bolt. It also includes a variety of lands to support its multi-colored nature, allowing the player to cast powerful spells like Tribal Flames. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional advantage to the deck. Overall, the goal is to dominate the opponent early on through consistent damage and efficient card plays.

The deck focuses on putting creatures with cycling abilities into the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. Using cards like Grief and Curator of Mysteries to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while accelerating the deck's own game plan with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while controlling the board with countermagic like Force of Negation. The deck aims to execute its combo efficiently and quickly to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive card plays to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing a mix of discard spells, removal, and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while dealing consistent damage. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Grief allows for constant hand disruption, while cards like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt offer efficient removal options. The deck's strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing cards that provide early disruption and pressure on the opponent. It includes a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, along with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The creatures in the deck also contribute to the aggro strategy, with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief providing early threats. Additionally, the deck includes some late-game value cards like Kolaghan's Command and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Overall, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan while maintaining a strong board presence.

The deck revolves around generating mana quickly and efficiently while setting up big plays with Primeval Titan, utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for explosive turns. The goal is to ramp up and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to deal massive amounts of damage quickly. With the ability to tutor for key pieces with cards like Expedition Map and Tolaria West, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful lands and creatures.

This deck is focused on assembling the Amulet Titan combo quickly to generate large amounts of mana and win the game. It utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to accelerate mana production, while Primeval Titan searches for key lands like Boros Garrison and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The goal is to use the Titan's ability to put multiple lands into play at once, triggering Valakut's ability to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and The Mycosynth Gardens to support the combo.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt opponents' hands and board states. The deck also includes graveyard interaction with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Seasoned Pyromancer. With a mix of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and efficient removal like Fatal Push and Terminate, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the get-go and control the tempo of the game. It aims to be fast, disruptive, and resilient in the face of opposing strategies.

The deck focuses on using a variety of creature toolbox cards to assemble combos and control the board. It includes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes cards that can tutor for specific creatures like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, allowing for flexibility in finding the right creatures for the situation. Overall, the deck aims to use its creatures efficiently and strategically to outmaneuver and outvalue the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on utilizing creature toolbox cards to assemble key combo pieces for powerful synergy. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can search for specific creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to create game-winning combos. Cards like Delighted Halfling and Blood Artist provide additional value and synergy within the deck. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by leveraging its toolbox of creatures to create powerful and synergistic plays.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while controlling the game with efficient interaction through cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck takes advantage of powerful cantrips like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to dig for answers and maintain card advantage. It also includes disruptive elements like Unholy Heat and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder for additional card advantage and graveyard manipulation. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while hindering the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and utilizing cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and board presence. By casting spells with cascade, the deck can consistently put powerful threats into play while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. The combination of efficient creatures, cascade spells, and disruptive elements makes this deck a potent force in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This Jund Aggro deck utilizes the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring, allowing for a diverse and flexible mana base. It focuses on early disruption and removal with cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, Fatal Push, and Terminate. The deck also contains efficient threats such as Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Questing Druid to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with Unholy Heat and Wrenn and Six while maintaining card advantage with Mishra's Research Desk. The land base is optimized with fetch lands, dual lands, and Urza's Saga to ensure consistency and power.
